title: Aanvullend voorzieningen gebruiksonderzoek, 1979 - AVO 1979
authors: Mootz, M.J., Roelse, W., Sociaal en cultureel planbureau, SCP * Den Haag (primary investigator)
contributors: Sociaal en cultureel planbureau, SCP * Den HaagMinisterie van cultuur recreatie en maatschappelijk werk, CRM * Den Haag (research initiator)
Nss - nv. Vh. Ned. Stichting voor statistiek * Den Haag (data collector)
descriptions: Supplementary research to available CBS-studies of the use of a wide range of collective welfare facilities. Recreational, sports, cultural activities / use of public transport / social work facilities / information and aid services. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class/ politics/ religion/ consumption of durables/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership. The data- and documentation files of this dataset can be downloaded via the option Data Files.
